AVIF encoder notices and build provenance

The local @jsquash/avif 2.1.1 encoder is distributed under Apache-2.0
(see avif-LICENSE). Its avif_enc.wasm matches the binary at jSquash commit
b7fa9ac9ec02f224847ad23d19d115f9e296a368, SHA-256
 d9f2a95164362af48558d176e619becfd49dd97b50b86c679b47100860522b3d.

The single-threaded encoder build recipe names:
- libavif 1.0.1: avif-libavif-LICENSE
- libaom 3.7.0: avif-libaom-LICENSE and avif-libaom-PATENTS
- SharpYUV from libwebp commit e2c85878f6a33f29948b43d3492d9cdaf801aa54:
  avif-libwebp-COPYING and avif-libwebp-PATENTS
- Emscripten 3.1.57: avif-emscripten-LICENSE and
  avif-emscripten-COPYRIGHT (musl libc)

Build recipe:
https://github.com/jamsinclair/jSquash/blob/b7fa9ac9ec02f224847ad23d19d115f9e296a368/packages/avif/codec/Makefile
https://github.com/jamsinclair/jSquash/blob/b7fa9ac9ec02f224847ad23d19d115f9e296a368/packages/avif/codec/package.json

The libwebp patent notice above is also identical to the notice at the
libwebp commit used by @jsquash/webp 1.5.0 (d2e245ea9e959a5a79e1db0ed2085206947e98f2).
